definitions.name: transforms
definitions.what: The rotation and translation fields of every ranked prediction row of the arm's docking.out (all fields of the row except the last), in file order.

definitions.name: scores
definitions.what: The score field (the last field) of every ranked prediction row of the arm's docking.out, in file order.

definitions.name: coords
definitions.what: The x, y and z coordinate columns of every ATOM and HETATM record of the arm's assembled models, models taken in rank order.

definitions.name: dockq
definitions.what: The evaluator's DockQ value for each of the arm's assembled models, as one JSON array in rank order, in a file that holds no other number.

outputs.assembly: Run both commands for each arm as specified by view. Receptor records then decoygen ligand records then one END line; 50 ranked assembled models.

evaluator_contract.private_data: for each input, the native complex named in spec.reference, fetched by fetch_private.sh from its URL and checked against its SHA-256 and byte count
evaluator_contract.reads: the model_<rank>.pdb files under CMP_ARM_OUT, in rank order
evaluator_contract.invocation: BiotiteDockQ is constructed with parallel_io=False (models read in the evaluator's own process). The evaluator's Python code is a regular file kept in the harness and run by evaluate.sh as the venv interpreter followed by that file's path, never as a program read from standard input: PINDER's parallel reader starts its workers with the spawn method, which re-imports the main program from its file.
evaluator_contract.writes: CMP_EVAL_OUT/dockq.json, one JSON array of the DockQ values in rank order and no other number; any per-model detail goes to a separate file under CMP_EVAL_OUT
evaluator_contract.command_source: intake/brief.md, Comparison request, evaluator invocation correction
evaluator_contract.command_status: Harness invocation specified by brief; not an upstream standalone script. The harness Python file is not supplied during intake.

api.native_chains: Map to receptor and ligand chains of the corresponding native complex; exact labels must be established by evaluator.

metrics.name: wall
metrics.what: Trusted wall of the invocation: adapter and arm commands, plus the evaluator part.

timing_scope.includes: Adapter and arm commands, reconstruction and model assembly, plus evaluator part within trusted invocation wall.
timing_scope.setup: Outside trusted invocation wall; no setup duration measured.

scheduling.setup_anchors_profile: Use time remaining before run ceiling when args budget is absent; ceiling is not a target.
scheduling.reason: No calibration performed during intake; no evidence-based runtime estimates supplied.
scheduling.rules: Pipeline schedule only. Preserve failure/timeout files; do not rerun invocations. Never compute or assert inter-arm differences, tolerances or DockQ summaries in harness.

anchor_interface.run_anchors.sh: Writes out/anchors_measured.json as {}; no measurements or acceptance claims.
anchor_interface.run_command.sh: Brief permits A0 two commands once on f1a19 only as build smoke check; intake did not run it.

contract_limitations: This recording request contains no denser-search arm, no comparative tolerance and no quality summary. It cannot establish the original seed question about denser-search quality under a fixed spending cap. This is explicit scope, not a substituted experiment.
Only trusted invocation wall is a metric in the view. GPU activity, billed allocation cost and a total spending cap are not supplied. They cannot be claimed from this view.
Evaluator harness file and chain mapping implementation are specified but not supplied; execution preparation must implement them before paid work.
